hero.subtitle: Making China-Africa trade accessible to every African entrepreneur, regardless of size or capital.

mission.title: Democratizing access to Chinese products for Africa
mission.p1: Millions of African entrepreneurs want to import products from China but run into barriers: language, lack of trust in suppliers, no international payment methods, and logistical complexity.
mission.p2: BizKey was created to break down these barriers. Through artificial intelligence and our network of partners in China and Africa, we make China-Africa trade as simple as sending a WhatsApp message.

story.title: From idea to platform
story.p1: BizKey was founded in 2024 in Beijing by entrepreneurs passionate about the potential of China-Africa trade. The idea was born from a simple frustration: too many African entrepreneurs were losing money to Alibaba scams or didn't know how to get started.
story.p2: By combining our physical presence in China with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, we built a platform that lets any African entrepreneur find the right supplier, get a transparent quote, and pay with the tools they already use — Mobile Money, Wave, Orange Money.
story.p3: Today, we've supported over 300 successful orders across 8 Francophone African countries. Our goal is 10,000 by 2026, helping every African entrepreneur access the best Chinese products without risk or barriers.

values.title: What guides us
values.v1Desc: Detailed quotes, photos before shipping, real-time tracking. No surprises.
values.v2Desc: Mobile Money accepted, small quantities possible. For every entrepreneur.
values.v3Desc: Artificial intelligence to find the best suppliers in seconds.
values.v4Desc: Verified suppliers, quality control, guaranteed refund if something goes wrong.

faq.subtitle: Our model, our team, and our guarantees — in full transparency.
faq.a1: BizKey was founded in 2024 in Beijing by entrepreneurs working between China and Francophone Africa. The team combines a physical presence in China for quality control with contacts in Abidjan and Dakar for customer service.
faq.q2: Are you a middleman or an automated platform?
faq.a2: Both. AI does the research and analysis work in seconds, but humans based in China verify suppliers, inspect goods before shipping, and handle disputes. Technology speeds things up — it doesn't replace on-the-ground verification.
faq.a3: Two sources: a 5 to 10% commission on orders we manage end-to-end, and subscriptions/credits for using the analysis platform. We never take hidden commissions from Chinese suppliers — our recommendations are never bought.
faq.q4: Which countries are you present in?
faq.a4: We serve eight Francophone African countries: Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Guinea, Mali, Togo, DRC and Benin. Available mobile payment methods vary by country.
faq.q5: Is my data and product research confidential?
faq.a5: Yes. Your analyses and search history are only visible to you, protected at the database level. We never resell your product ideas or order volumes to third parties.
